title.narrative: Fortalecimiento estratégico ADELMorazán para la sostenibilidad territorial

description.narrative: The project seeks to generate a transformative impact on the rural productive fabric through the comprehensive strengthening of enterprises, micro and small enterprises, prioritizing women and young people as protagonists of change. Its growth will be promoted through business consulting, specialized training, technical assistance, commercial linkages, access to financing, support networks, fairs, national and international exchanges, articulation for marketing and mentoring programs, all in alliance with public and private institutions. A central axis will be training in innovation and technology – digital economy, digital thinking, female digital entrepreneurship and emerging technologies – promoting competitions, events, technological mentoring and the strategic use of digital platforms and social networks as marketing tools. In parallel, through alliances with experts in food security and climate change, sustainable and innovative agricultural practices with a market focus on vegetables, coffee and beekeeping will be implemented, along with climate adaptation strategies that reduce risks. Finally, institutional sustainability will be strengthened through the development of capacities, improvement of internal management (human talent, administration and finance), implementation of technological systems, organizational culture, succession policy, transparency, accountability and tools for measuring results, guaranteeing a solid structure that multiplies the impact in the long term.
